gelato_new_or_updated_search_orders_trig.description: Runs for each order added or changed in Gelato. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, orderType, orderReferenceId, customerReferenceId, fulfillmentStatus, financialStatus, currency, createdAt, updatedAt, items

gelato_new_search_orders_trigger.description: Runs each time an order is created in Gelato. Ones created before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, orderType, orderReferenceId, customerReferenceId, fulfillmentStatus, financialStatus, currency, createdAt, updatedAt, items
